newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi says Deng was a great statesman.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi says Deng was a great statesman.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi described Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping on Thursday as a great statesman who had led his country into the modern world.
In a message to Chinese Prime Minister Li Peng, Prodi said he was deeply saddened by the news that Deng had died on Wednesday at the age of 92.

"(Deng) was one of the great leaders of contemporary China, the father of economic reforms and the policy that opened China to the outside world, and was one of the main actors on the international political scene," Prodi said.
He added that Deng's efforts to modernise China "will remain a fixed reference point for his people, who are linked to the Italian people by strong ties of cooperation and friendship".
